page: Amazon Web Services m7i.metal-24xl is a bare-metal, general-purpose server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8488C processors. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, this server features 48 physical cores and 96 vCPUs running at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per physical core. The processor includes a 105 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated vector and matrix operations.

In benchmark evaluations, the m7i.metal-24xl demonstrates top-tier multi-core performance, placing in the top 10% for Geekbench multi-core and Passmark CPU scores. Its cryptographic capabilities are highlighted by a top-tier Passmark CPU encryption result, supported by hardware-accelerated AES and SHA instructions. The server also exhibits strong memory bandwidth, reaching 231.55 GB/sec for large-block read operations, and delivers high throughput in data-intensive tasks such as Redis SET operations and static web serving.

While the instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 38 Gbps, it lacks local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware, meaning storage-heavy or GPU-dependent workloads must rely on network-attached resources. Given its balanced resource density and high-performance multi-core execution, the m7i.metal-24xl is highly suited for enterprise general-purpose workloads, large-scale web serving, database operations, software compilation, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
